title: FC-CONAN: An Exhaustively Paired Dataset for Robust Evaluation of Retrieval Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the underestimation of retrieval system performance (lower-bound bias) by comparing evaluation metrics computed on a sparsely annotated baseline dataset (CONAN) versus four quality-graded partitions of an exhaustively annotated dataset (FC-CONAN).
Assessing the effectiveness and robustness of various text-embedding and retrieval systems in correctly recommending appropriate counter-narratives to combat Islamophobic (anti-Muslim) hate speech.
